name: limit_two_bodies_do_not_export
why: THE REFUSAL THAT IS THE REASON FOR THE OPERATION. An STL of two bodies is two separate shells: it opens, it gets sliced and printed, and the printer does not know which of the two was the part. No error, anywhere in the chain -- and the measure of the file (it exists, it weighs something) does not catch it. That is why the check runs BEFORE writing, and not after.
_why_the_sentence: the refusal must say WHAT was wrong, not «I do not export»: whoever reads does not have the part in front of them. And it must say how to override it, because one day somebody will be right.
